_notes.targetFps: Optional per-camera key. Add lane_config.cameras[].targetFps to set per-stream target FPS. If omitted, stream density falls back to global TARGET_FPS.

_about.name: Self-checkout lane with age verification
_about.summary: One lane runs two pipelines at once: a product camera detects items with YOLO11n and classifies them with EfficientNet-B0, and a customer-facing camera detects faces and estimates each customer's age
_about.cameras: Two cameras at 15 fps, one scanning products and one facing the customer
_about.why_run_it: Shows whether a system can run a complete lane, scanning plus age verification for age-restricted sales, at the frame rate each camera needs
